title: Natural sunlight-driven phototransformation of the expectorant drug ambroxol in freshwaters
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00205B, Paper
Ying Zhang, Xiaoci Li, Jing Chen, Lei Zhou, Mingbao Feng, Jean-Marc Chovelon, Yuefei Ji
